Policy-ID: TRACKER-MIGRATION-V2
Status: ACTIVE

Requests are identified by a Migration marker on an open source issue and must reference an existing open code change in this repository. For Jira sources, publish to Linear team OPS, project Reliability. Map Jira Highest/High/Medium to Linear 1/2/3. Preserve the source summary and complete description, then append a blank line and Migration source: <source-identifier>. Reuse a target only when that exact provenance exists; otherwise create one. After confirming the target, add exactly Migrated to <target-identifier>. as a source comment. Never close the source, modify code, or touch unrelated records.
